about: A short 300 mg aspirin course for pain precedes the first 100 mg daily supply on 20 May 2026. No proton pump inhibitor covers that start. A later note records a peptic ulcer diagnosed in 2024.

The record holds previous reflux oesophagitis and low-dose aspirin is started in May 2026, but pantoprazole (Somac, a proton pump inhibitor) is supplied from two weeks before the aspirin and every month after, so nothing is omitted.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about a previous peptic ulcer or reflux oesophagitis. The seven-day Nexium Hp7 supply suggests a past ulcer. Its course ended before the first low-dose aspirin supply on 3 June 2026. No proton pump inhibitor covers that start.
